---
name: Product & UX
about: Report a user-facing problem or propose a change to the CLI, SDKs, viewer, or other product surfaces.
---

## User problem

<!-- What is the user trying to do, and where do they get stuck? -->

## Resulting behavior

<!-- Describe what users should be able to do or see. Note any decisions still open. -->

## Affected scenarios

<!-- List the user tasks this would change. Include the ordinary path and relevant errors, refusals, or recovery paths. Include SDK callers when their workflow is affected. -->

## Before and after

<!--
For CLI changes, sketch a full terminal interaction for each distinct affected scenario.
Use two fenced text blocks with matching setup and inputs. Label them A. Before and B. After (proposed).
In A, show the current commands or workaround. In B, show the proposed commands.
Show what the user types and sees through the end of the task, including prompts, output or errors, and follow-up commands that matter.
Include exit status or artifact paths when they affect the next step. Label illustrative output as faux.
-->

## Demo and evidence

<!-- If this concerns the viewer or another visible product surface, attach screenshots or photos for static behavior, or a short video or GIF for an interaction. Show the current problem or a reference for the proposed behavior. Omit credentials and private data from attachments and transcripts. -->

## How to test

<!-- Share the setup and steps to reproduce the problem, or describe how to check the proposed behavior. Include the FX version and platform when relevant. -->

## Caveats

<!-- Describe relevant constraints, edge cases, or tradeoffs. -->
